Character.Name: Bricker
Character.Description: Bricker is the Field lead of the Kiln Union, working the abandoned foundry belt. sets the crew plan and gives every member a clear way out. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: soot-dark work armor with ember-orange face glass.
Character.Title: Field lead

Character.Name: Spall
Character.Description: Spall is the Quartermaster of the Kiln Union, working the abandoned foundry belt. keeps the crew supplied and knows which kit can be repaired in the field. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: soot-dark work armor with ember-orange face glass.
Character.Title: Quartermaster

Character.Name: Rivet
Character.Description: Rivet is the Pathfinder of the Kiln Union, working the abandoned foundry belt. reads routes, sightlines, and exits before the rest of the crew arrives. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: soot-dark work armor with ember-orange face glass.
Character.Title: Pathfinder

Character.Name: Gauge
Character.Description: Gauge is the Riflehand of the Kiln Union, working the abandoned foundry belt. holds a steady lane and calls out changing enemy positions. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: soot-dark work armor with ember-orange face glass.
Character.Title: Riflehand

Character.Name: Cinderjack
Character.Description: Cinderjack is the Bulwark of the Kiln Union, working the abandoned foundry belt. takes the exposed approach so lighter crew members can reposition. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: soot-dark work armor with ember-orange face glass.
Character.Title: Bulwark

Character.Name: Fuse
Character.Description: Fuse is the Mechanic of the Kiln Union, working the abandoned foundry belt. keeps radios, doors, lifts, and improvised tools working under pressure. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: soot-dark work armor with ember-orange face glass.
Character.Title: Mechanic

Character.Name: Trowel
Character.Description: Trowel is the Medic of the Kiln Union, working the abandoned foundry belt. stabilizes injured crew and refuses to leave anyone behind. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: soot-dark work armor with ember-orange face glass.
Character.Title: Medic

Character.Name: Slag
Character.Description: Slag is the Marksman of the Kiln Union, working the abandoned foundry belt. spots threats early and shares a clean shot with the rest of the team. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: soot-dark work armor with ember-orange face glass.
Character.Title: Marksman

Chatter.Description: Custom event chatter for Bricker. plainspoken shop-floor radio calls; they explain the job and never hide behind riddles.
Spawned: Bricker, Field lead, reporting from the abandoned foundry belt.
WakeUp: Eyes up. Kiln Union still has work to finish.
Attacking: Bricker taking the field lead lane. finish the shift, bring everyone home.
Chasing: Keep my signal. I'm pushing them toward the the abandoned foundry belt.
Waiting: Holding position. Check your route before you move.
FriendDied: We lost one of ours. Mark the spot; the rest of us keep moving.
EnemyDown: Bricker confirms one hostile down. Watch the next angle.
Wounded: Bricker is hit! Still moving; get me behind cover!
Died: Tell the crew I made it this far with them.
Chatter.Name: Bricker - Kiln Union combat chatter
